questions.question: What is the role of a topic sentence?
A coherent paragraph should use linking words.
La bonne réponse attendue est : moreover.
Which sentence is the best concluding sentence?
choices: To sum up, social media can be useful if used responsibly.

questions.question: Examples should support the main idea of the paragraph.
La bonne réponse attendue est : for example.
Which option best improves style in formal writing?
Planning ideas before writing usually improves paragraph quality.
